1     (a)  Sketch the graphs of cos θ and sec θ, on the same set of axes, in the interval 0 ≤ θ ≤ 2π
(4)
       (b)  Sketch the graphs of sin θ and cosec θ, on the same set of axes, in the interval 0 ≤ θ ≤ 2π
(4)
       (c)  Sketch the graphs of tan θ and cot θ, on the same set of axes, in the interval 0 ≤ θ ≤ 2π
(4)
(Total for question 1 is 12 marks)

2       Solve, for 0 ≤ θ ≤ 2π, the equation, 
2 cosec θ = 5
         Give your answers to 3 significant figures.
(Total for question 2 is 4 marks)

3      Solve, for 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π, the equation, 
2 cot x = 3 sec x
         Give your answers in terms of π.
(Total for question 3 is 5 marks)

4      Solve, for -π ≤ x ≤ π, the equation, 
5 cos x + cot x = 0
        Give your answers to 2 decimal places where appropriate.
(Total for question 4 is 5 marks)

5      Solve, for 0 ≤ x ≤ 360, the equation, 
sec 2 x + 5 sec x + 6 = 0 
         Give your answers to 1 decimal place where appropriate.
(Total for question 5 is 5 marks)

6      Solve, for 0 ≤ x ≤ 360, the equation, 
cot 2 x = 9
         Give your answers to 1 decimal place.
(Total for question 6 is 5 marks)

7       Solve, for -180 ≤ θ ≤ 180, the equation, 
sec (2 θ + 10) = -1.3
         Give your answers to 1 decimal place.
(Total for question 7 is 4 marks)

(2)
8     (a)  Use the identity cos 2 θ + sin 2 θ = 1 to prove that tan 2 θ = sec 2 θ – 1  
       (b)  Solve, for 0 ≤ θ ≤ 360, the equation, 
tan 2 θ + sec 2 θ + 5 sec θ = 2   
(5)
             Give your answers to 1 decimal place. 
(Total for question 8 is 7 marks)

cosec 2 θ + cot 2 θ = 3   
(5)
             Give your answers in terms of π. 
(Total for question 9 is 7 marks)

10      Solve, for 0 ≤ x ≤ 360, the equation, 
tan 2 x + 4 sec x – 2 = 0 
         Give your answers to 1 decimal place.
(Total for question 10 is 5 marks)

11      Solve, for -180 ≤ x ≤ 180, the equation, 
2 cot 2 x – cosec 2 x + cosec x = 4 
         Give your answers to 1 decimal place where appropriate.
(Total for question 11 is 5 marks)

12       Prove the identities:
         (a)  sec 2 x – cosec 2 x  ≡  tan 2 x – cot 2 x
(2)
         (b)  (sec x – cos x)2  ≡  tan 2 x – sin 2 x
(2)

         (a)  sec 4 x – tan 4 x  ≡  1 + 2 tan 2 x

can be written in the form 
a sec 2 x + b sec x  + c = 0
